thread:
Olivia Hayes: Heads up — inbound wire labeled for a new customer (Acme Analytics) hit our Barclays account this morning. Amount £12,345.67. Bank reference truncated to 'Acme/INV/99...' so PO (PO-9987) isn't visible and auto-apply failed. Customer needs this applied to their billing to complete onboarding. I attached the bank remittance screenshot from their portal. Can payments ops advise next steps?

payments-bot: New inbound payment detected — trace_id: TRACE-0xA3B2C1 — acct: REDWOOD-GBL-01 — currency: GBP — amount: 12345.67 — status: RECEIVED (unapplied).

Raj Patel: Thanks Olivia — can you confirm sender bank and any full reference line? Truncated refs are usually an intermediary/bank formatting issue. If we can't get a clear ref we need an MT103 or correspondent-bank trace to reconcile.

Olivia Hayes: Sender bank is Barclays (GB). I only have the customer's screenshot; it shows beneficiary = Redwood Inference, value date = 2026-03-16, payment ref field: "Acme/INV/99...". Customer support says their AP system sent PO-9987 in the remittance but they don't see it in the outgoing message.

Sam Li: @Raj I'll run a ledger search now. Command I usually use: ```financecli ledger find --amount 12345.67 --currency GBP --date 2026-03-16``` — will paste results.

Sam Li: (results) no auto-match found against INV-2026-9987; candidate ledger id: LEDGER-77821 (unapplied). No metadata for PO.

Raj Patel: Ok — next steps: 1) Ask customer to request an MT103/trace from their bank (screenshot of full SWIFT MT103 message or payment advice). 2) If they can't, request Barclays (our bank) to provide the full incoming message including fields 70/72 (remittance info). 3) If we get confirmation from the customer (email with PO and invoice number) we can provisionally apply to INV-2026-9987 but mark as pending reconciliation.

Emily Chen: From ACME side — they need billing cleared today to finish onboarding. Is it safe to provisional-apply and then reverse if mismatch? Any risk of double-credit?

Raj Patel: There is a small risk if the payment actually belonged to a different invoice. To mitigate: create a provisional allocation note, tag it with ticket FIN-4567 and the trace_id, and set an automatic review/lock for 14 days. If we later find mismatch, reverse and notify customer. Ops prefers to avoid refunds if possible.

Olivia Hayes: I've opened FIN-4567 and attached the customer's screenshot + support transcript. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-4567 — customer (Acme) on a dedicated contract so we should avoid blocking onboarding.

payments-bot: Assigned to @Raj Patel, @Sam Li. SLA: 24h.

Raj Patel: I'm going to request MT103 from Barclays via our bank rep this morning (ticket BANK-TR-918). If they can provide 70/72 fields we should get the full PO string. I'll update FIN-4567 once we have the MT103.

Sam Li: I've provisionally applied the amount to INV-2026-9987 with note "provisional apply per customer confirmation; pending MT103". Ledger entry LEDGER-77821 updated and flagged.

Emily Chen: Thanks all. I'll tell the customer we put a provisional apply and that we're waiting on the bank trace to finalize. Will ask them to push their bank for MT103. :thumbsup:

Raj Patel: One more thing — if the intermediary truncated the field, sometimes the full PO appears in the ordering customer fields (50a) rather than remittance (70). When/if we get MT103, check 50a and 70/72.

Olivia Hayes: Noted. Closing loop for now — will follow up in FIN-4567. If bank provides MT103 and it doesn't match, we'll reverse and notify Acme.

payments-bot: FIN-4567 status updated -> IN_PROGRESS (assigned: Raj Patel).
